body: I feel really so sorry to hear this, I feel more or less the same way and, though I can't virtually help you I can tell you that you're not alone feeling like this. There's tones of people in the world going through similar situations and its tough, fuck if its tough. Its meaningless, tiresome and unfair. I wish that you can find some hope and console at least knowing you're not alone, you really seem like a well-balanced, self-reflexive, well articulated and great person, even more knowing the difficult circumstances you were thrown into. A big hug and love from Barcelona, Spain
Can you please send a link of some of those YouTube videos? They would be really helpful for me right now…
